Our strengths

Designed for Professional Investors

Working within a licensed regulatory framework, we combine in-depth company research with a long-term perspective to provide Professional Investors with private equity market information and advisory services.

REGULATORY FRAMEWORK

A licensed regulatory framework

Operating through an entity licensed by Hong Kong’s Securities and Futures Commission for Type 1, 4 and 9 regulated activities, we bring together legal and compliance expertise, with attention to the scope of our services, information disclosure and risk communication.

GROWTH EQUITY

A focus on growth equity

We focus on growth-stage companies in Greater China from Pre-A to Series C, providing Professional Investors with relevant market information, project information and advisory services.

LONG-TERM VALUE

A long-term view of value

Taking a long-term view of business development and industry evolution, we consider growth potential, investment horizons and uncertainty around exits to help investors understand both opportunities and risks.

Our philosophy

Understand the drivers of growth Assess long-term value

From secondary markets to private equity investing in the primary market, we can apply our investment capabilities flexibly. We believe that assessing an investment opportunity begins with a deep understanding of a company and its industry. Research must identify what drives growth, examine whether that growth can be sustained and consider the conditions required for expectations to be realised.

Focus on the sources of growth

Starting with underlying demand, technological developments and the competitive landscape, we examine a company’s position within its industry and identify the structural factors that drive growth.

Focus on business fundamentals

We examine business models, competitive advantages and key differentiators, studying how companies create value, build barriers to competition and translate their potential into sustained business results.

Assess risk with care

We examine valuations, the completeness of information, investment horizons and potential exit routes, testing the assumptions behind growth expectations and assessing the risks if those expectations are not met.

Our culture

Truth Collaboration Candour

We believe that expertise develops through continuous learning and that trust is built through everyday practice. Respect for facts, open collaboration and candid communication guide how we work together.

Truth / Respect the facts

We value reliable sources and evidence, encourage scrutiny of existing judgements and continually review and refine our views as new facts emerge.

Collaboration / Exchange perspectives

We respect diverse professional backgrounds and independent thinking, bringing different ideas into dialogue and testing our views through open discussion to deepen our understanding.

Candour / Communicate clearly

We explain the basis of our information, the scope of our services and the uncertainties that remain, building lasting trust through responsible communication and continued follow-up.

Our people

Diverse expertise Collaborative analysis

The HighBlock Securities team brings together experienced professionals from Hong Kong and mainland China with backgrounds in investment research, law and compliance. Drawing on their practical experience, our people assess projects through the lenses of industry development, company value and regulatory requirements, providing investors with services that combine research depth with professional standards.
